Ava (People Ops): Quick heads up — we're publishing a short clarification to the handbook (Leaves & Time) that separates bereavement vs compassionate leave language and adds examples for caregivers. Rolling out a manager-facing 6-question quiz + a 15-min microtraining video. RSVP + ack links below.
Ravi (People Ops): timeline? is this opt-in or mandatory for managers?
Ava (People Ops): Timeline: announcement live today. Managers: quiz is mandatory for all people managers; completion window = 2 weeks. Individual ICs: policy ack required by end of next month, microtraining optional but encouraged. Link: https://tiny.redwood/handbook-clarify (handbook diff) Form: https://tiny.redwood/ack-form
Devon (Eng Manager): APAC managers — will there be a live session or only recorded? can we get a bulk roster export to track our team completions?
Ava (People Ops): We'll run 2 live drop-in sessions (EMEA-friendly + APAC-friendly) next Wed/Thu, plus recording posted to the People Ops channel. We'll push a CSV export of manager completion status to the managers group every Friday. ETA first export = Friday 2919003800.
Mara (HRBP): I'll own the CSV export automation. CSV header will be something like:
```
manager_email,team_size,quiz_completed,quiz_score,training_viewed,ack_completed,ack_ts
```
Will also add a column for notes for reasonable accommodation requests.
Liam (Legal): Quick note — wording change is clarificatory; not a material term change. No retroactive adjustments intended. If anyone flags a contract-specific concern, please route to me before sending an ack request to that person.
Ravi (People Ops): what's pass threshold on the manager quiz?
Ava (People Ops): 80% pass required. Managers who don't pass will get a reminder + a second attempt window of 7 days. Failing twice -> 1:1 with HRBP to review.
Devon (Eng Manager): can we get the quiz results via API? bulk ingest into our LMS would be helpful.
training-bot: Quiz "Policy — Bereavement vs Compassionate" created by Ava. Quiz ID: pol-2026-09-15-001. Results API endpoint: https://api.redwood.test/training/results/pol-2026-09-15-001
Mara (HRBP): I'll post a short template email managers can use to prompt their teams. Ava — can you approve the copy? here is draft:

```
Subject: Quick handbook update — please review + ack
Hi team — we updated the Leaves & Time section in the handbook to clarify bereavement vs compassionate leave and added examples. Please read the short diff and complete the acknowledgment by MM/DD. Managers: please complete the 15-min microtraining + 6-question quiz within two weeks.
Thanks, <manager name>
```
Ava (People Ops): LGTM, small tweak: add line about accommodations and a link to request form. I'll post final copy in #people-ops pinned resources.
Ravi (People Ops): action items I pulled:
- Ava: post final email template + schedule (owner)
- Mara: automation for CSV export (owner)
- Liam: spot-check contract flags (owner)
- training-bot: enable API + weekly export
Deadline: quiz window closes in 2 weeks (2919003456 + 14 days). Will send reminders 1 week and 3 days before close. :alarm_clock:
Devon (Eng Manager): noted, will nudge our managers. thanks.
Ava (People Ops): Thanks all. I'll drop the pinned links and calendar invites in ~30m. If you want to opt a specific role out for legal reasons, ping @Liam directly. :white_check_mark:
